title: Anton-Bch/isoform-nf-core pipeline parameters
description: General-purpose Nextflow pipeline for isoform switch analysis

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a samplesheet with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. Required columns are `sample`, `condition`, `replicate`, `fastq_1`, and `strandedness`; `fastq_2` and `batch` are optional.

sra_manifest.description: Optional CSV file containing SRA run accessions and sample metadata.
sra_manifest.help_text: Use this instead of `--input` to download public SRA runs before running the normal FASTQ-based pipeline. Required columns are `sample`, `condition`, `replicate`, `run_accession`, and `strandedness`; `batch` is optional.

salmon_input.description: Optional CSV file describing precomputed Salmon quantification directories.
salmon_input.help_text: Use this instead of --input or --sra_manifest when quant.sf results already exist. Required columns are sample, condition, replicate, and quant_dir; batch is optional. Each quant_dir basename must match its sample name and contain quant.sf.

sra_prefetch_max_size.description: Maximum SRA archive size accepted by prefetch.
sra_prefetch_max_size.help_text: Passed to `prefetch --max-size` for SRA mode. Increase this for large public runs, or lower it to fail early during smoke tests.

contrasts.description: Optional CSV file describing pairwise condition contrasts.
contrasts.help_text: Use this file to define dataset-specific comparisons without changing pipeline code. It must contain `contrast`, `case`, and `control` columns whose condition values match the `condition` column in the samplesheet.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome related files and options required for the workflow.

genome.help_text:
If using a reference genome configured in the pipeline using iGenomes, use this parameter to give the ID for the reference. This is then used to build the full paths for all required reference genome files e.g. `--genome GRCh38`. 

See the [nf-core website docs](https://nf-co.re/usage/reference_genomes) for more details.

transcript_fasta.help_text: Transcript sequences used to build the Salmon index. The transcript IDs should match the transcript IDs in the GTF annotation.

genome_fasta.description: Optional path to genome FASTA file.
genome_fasta.help_text: If provided, Salmon builds a decoy-aware gentrome index using the transcript FASTA plus genome sequences as decoys. This usually improves mapping specificity.

gtf.description: Path to transcript annotation GTF file.
gtf.help_text: Annotation used by Salmon for transcript-to-gene mapping and later by IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR to connect transcript abundance to gene/isoform structure.

salmon_lib_type.help_text: Leave unset to derive Salmon library type from samplesheet strandedness and single-end/paired-end status. Samplesheet 'auto' is passed as Salmon libType A. Advanced users can provide any supported Salmon libType explicitly.

igenomes_ignore.description: Do not load the iGenomes reference config.
igenomes_ignore.help_text: Do not load `igenomes.config` when running the pipeline. You may choose this option if you observe clashes between custom parameters and those supplied in `igenomes.config`.

igenomes_base.description: The base path to the igenomes reference files

isoformswitchanalyzer_options.title: IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR options
isoformswitchanalyzer_options.description: Options controlling the downstream isoform switch analysis.

run_isar.help_text: Disable this for debugging or for Salmon-only preprocessing runs.

isar_dif_cutoff.description: Minimum absolute isoform fraction difference used by IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR.
isar_dif_cutoff.help_text: A value of 0.1 means an isoform must change by at least 10 percentage points in usage to be considered as a switch candidate.

isar_qvalue_cutoff.description: Multiple-testing corrected q-value cutoff for isoform switch testing.

isar_top_n.description: Number of top switch candidates to export when a statistical switch test is run.

run_isar_visualization.help_text: Creates official IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR switchPlot pages, volcano, top-gene, per-gene isoform usage, PTC summary, and candidate CSV outputs after the ISAR step. No-switch or import-only runs finish gracefully with notes and empty summary tables.

isar_visualization_top_n.description: Number of top switching genes used for ISAR visualization outputs.

run_isar_contrast_summary.description: Generate cross-contrast summaries for significant isoform switches.
run_isar_contrast_summary.help_text: Creates a per-comparison bar plot and an UpSet-style intersection plot from the analyzed IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR result. This is most useful when --contrasts contains multiple pairwise comparisons.

isar_contrast_summary_top_n.description: Number of largest isoform-switch intersections to show in the UpSet-style contrast summary plot.

run_go_enrichment.description: Run optional GO enrichment on significant isoform-switching genes after IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR.
run_go_enrichment.help_text: When enabled, the pipeline summarizes significant switching genes per contrast and runs WebGestaltR over-representation analysis. This is off by default because it adds an extra runtime dependency and may require online WebGestalt/database access.

go_organism.description: WebGestaltR organism code used for GO enrichment.

go_gene_id_type.description: WebGestaltR gene identifier type used for significant and background gene lists.
go_gene_id_type.help_text: Use genesymbol for gene symbols or another WebGestaltR-supported identifier type when the supplied reference uses different gene IDs.

go_database.description: WebGestaltR enrichment database used for GO enrichment.

go_reference_gene_file.description: Optional newline-delimited background gene universe for GO enrichment.
go_reference_gene_file.help_text: Defaults to all ISAR-tested genes for each contrast. Provide this only when you need a custom reference universe.

run_pfam_prepare.description: Prepare amino-acid FASTA input for optional Pfam domain annotation.
run_pfam_prepare.help_text: After ISAR, the pipeline can extract amino-acid sequences from significant switching genes. The resulting FASTA can be scanned with pfam_scan.pl or HMMER against a Pfam database. This is enabled automatically when --pfam_db is provided.

pfam_results.description: Optional pfam_scan.pl result file to import into IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR.
pfam_results.help_text: When provided, the pipeline imports Pfam domain hits with IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR::analyzePFAM() and can create Pfam consequence and domain architecture visualizations. This overrides --pfam_db / pipeline-run Pfam scanning.

pfam_db.description: Optional Pfam database directory for running pfam_scan.pl inside the pipeline.
pfam_db.help_text: The directory should contain Pfam-A.hmm and preferably the hmmpress index files Pfam-A.hmm.h3f, .h3i, .h3m, and .h3p. If --pfam_results is not supplied and --pfam_db is supplied, the pipeline runs pfam_scan.pl on the prepared amino-acid FASTA.

pfam_top_n.description: Number of strongest switch candidates to include in the Pfam preparation table.

run_pfam_visualization.description: Generate Pfam domain consequence and domain architecture visualizations when Pfam results are imported.

pfam_visualization_top_n.description: Number of Pfam domain-change candidates to plot.

run_iupred2a.description: Run optional IUPred2A/ANCHOR2 disorder annotation on significant isoform switch candidates.
run_iupred2a.help_text: When enabled, the pipeline extracts amino-acid sequences for significant switch candidates, runs IUPred2A with ANCHOR2, converts the output into the format expected by IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR, and imports IDR annotations with analyzeIUPred2A().

iupred2a_container.help_text: Overrides the default IUPred2A image. The image must provide python3, /opt/iupred2a/iupred2a.py, and ps so Nextflow can collect task metrics.

iupred2a_top_n.description: Number of strongest switch candidates to include in the IUPred2A preparation table.

run_signalp.description: Run optional SignalP signal peptide annotation on significant isoform switch candidates.
run_signalp.help_text: When enabled, the pipeline extracts amino-acid sequences for significant switch candidates, runs SignalP 5.0b in eukaryotic mode, and imports signal peptide annotations with analyzeSignalP(). A licensed user-supplied container must be provided with --signalp_container.

signalp_container.description: User-supplied SignalP 5.0b container image or local SIF path.
signalp_container.help_text: Required with --run_signalp. Obtain SignalP 5.0b under the appropriate DTU license, build or provision the container within that license, and provide an image reference supported by the selected container profile. The pipeline does not redistribute or automatically download SignalP.

signalp_top_n.description: Number of strongest switch candidates to include in the SignalP preparation table.

run_deeptmhmm.description: Run optional DeepTMHMM topology annotation on significant isoform switch candidates.
run_deeptmhmm.help_text: When enabled, the pipeline extracts amino-acid sequences for significant switch candidates, runs DeepTMHMM, converts the 3-line topology output into the format expected by IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR, and imports topology annotations with analyzeDeepTMHMM().

deeptmhmm_top_n.description: Number of strongest switch candidates to include in the DeepTMHMM preparation table.

run_deeploc2.description: Run optional DeepLoc2 subcellular localization annotation on significant isoform switch candidates.
run_deeploc2.help_text: When enabled, the pipeline extracts amino-acid sequences for significant switch candidates, runs DeepLoc 2.1 with the fast CPU model, converts the output into the format expected by IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR, and imports localization annotations with analyzeDeepLoc2(). A licensed user-supplied container must be provided with --deeploc2_container.

deeploc2_container.description: User-supplied DeepLoc 2.1 container image or local SIF path.
deeploc2_container.help_text: Required with --run_deeploc2. Obtain DeepLoc 2.1 under the appropriate DTU license, build or provision the container within that license, and provide an image reference supported by the selected container profile. The pipeline does not redistribute or automatically download DeepLoc.

deeploc2_top_n.description: Number of strongest switch candidates to include in the DeepLoc2 preparation table.

run_annotated_switch_plots.description: Generate rich IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR switchPlot outputs from the most annotated switchAnalyzeRlist available.
run_annotated_switch_plots.help_text: This downstream plotting step uses the chained annotated ISAR object produced by optional Pfam, IUPred2A, SignalP, DeepTMHMM, and DeepLoc2 imports. It can also run with only the base ISAR object, but it is most useful after annotations are enabled.

annotated_switch_top_n.description: Number of top genes to plot in the annotated switch plot module when --annotated_switch_genes is not supplied.

annotated_switch_genes.description: Optional comma-separated gene IDs or gene names to plot in the annotated switch plot module.
annotated_switch_genes.help_text: When optional annotation modules are enabled, these genes are also force-included during annotation FASTA preparation so requested plots can show available domains, topology, localization, signal peptide, or disorder annotations even if the genes are not significant in the current run.

annotated_switch_condition1.description: Optional first condition name for annotated switch plots. Defaults to the first comparison in the ISAR object.

annotated_switch_condition2.description: Optional second condition name for annotated switch plots. Defaults to the first comparison in the ISAR object.

annotated_switch_plot_topology.description: Request topology tracks in annotated switch plots when topology annotations are available.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

hook_url.description: Incoming hook URL for messaging service
hook_url.help_text: Incoming hook URL for messaging service. Currently, MS Teams and Slack are supported.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

modules_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of nf-core module test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
